cm.resource.customizations.health.secrets.d:
local hs = {status = 'Progressing', message = 'Waiting for Doppler SecretSyncReady'}
if obj.status ~= nil and obj.status.conditions ~= nil then
  for _, c in ipairs(obj.status.conditions) do
    if c.type == 'secrets.doppler.com/SecretSyncReady' then
      if c.status == 'True' then
        hs = {status = 'Healthy', message = 'Operator reports SecretSyncReady; verify keys and freshness separately'}
      elseif c.status == 'False' then
        return {status = 'Degraded', message = 'Doppler secret delivery failed; inspect securely'}
      end
    end
    if c.type == 'secrets.doppler.com/DeploymentReloadReady' and c.status == 'False' then
      return {status = 'Degraded', message = 'Doppler reload failed; automatic Deployment updates are not permitted'}
    end
  end
end
return hs
cm.resource.customizations.health.apiextens:
local hs = {status = 'Progressing', message = 'Waiting for CRD Established'}
if obj.status ~= nil and obj.status.conditions ~= nil then
  for _, c in ipairs(obj.status.conditions) do
    if c.type == 'NamesAccepted' and c.status == 'False' then
      return {status = 'Degraded', message = 'CRD name conflict'}
    end
    if c.type == 'Terminating' and c.status == 'True' then
      return {status = 'Degraded', message = 'CRD is terminating'}
    end
    if c.type == 'Established' and c.status == 'True' then
      hs = {status = 'Healthy', message = 'CRD Established'}
    end
  end
end
return hs
